name: Bonk
text: Out. Next roll at Disadvantage while your ears ring.

name: Glasses or hat knocked flying
text: Out. Gain 1 Stress as the gym laughs.

name: Headshot
text: Out, but Coach calls it: the thrower is out too.

name: Smacked in the face
text: Out. Dazed.

name: Bloody nose
text: Out. Dazed. Sent to the nurse.

name: Bell rung
text: Out. Minor Concussion. Body Save. Success: only Dazed, and 0 Trauma instead of +1. Failure: Minor Concussion, which is Dazed and -10 Handle until a Long Rest.

name: Trapped against the chest
text: Handle Check: success catches it, and the thrower is out instead. Failure: out.

name: Thud
text: Out.

name: Stung
text: Out. A red welt in the ball's pattern lasts the rest of the day.

name: Winded
text: Out. Next relevant physical Check at Disadvantage.

name: Knocked down
text: Out.

name: Breath knocked out
text: Out. Dazed. Gain 1 Stress.

name: Everyone winces
text: Out. Gain 1 Stress.

name: Doubled over
text: Out. Lose the next Movement Stage.

name: Down
text: Out. Knocked down.

name: Down and out
text: Out. Knocked down. Dazed.

name: Down and out
text: Out. Knocked down. Dazed. Gain 1 Stress.

name: Nobody will forget this
text: Out. Knocked down. Dazed. Gain 2 Stress.

name: Brushed the sleeve
text: Out, though you swear it missed. Gain 1 Stress.

name: Thwack
text: Out.

name: Stinging arm
text: Out. Next roll with that arm at Disadvantage.

name: Knocked loose
text: Out. Whatever that hand holds is dropped.

name: Dead arm
text: Out. Rolls with that arm at Disadvantage for the rest of the scene.

name: Dead arm
text: Out. Rolls with that arm at Disadvantage for the rest of the scene. Gain 1 Stress.

name: Caught it!
text: Handle Check: success, the thrower is out instead and you stay in. Failure: out.

name: Fumbled catch
text: Handle Check at Disadvantage to hold on: success, the thrower is out instead. Failure: out.

name: Jammed finger
text: Out. Next roll with that hand at Disadvantage.

name: Bent-back fingers
text: Out. Rolls with that hand at Disadvantage until a Long Rest.

name: Bent-back fingers
text: Out. Rolls with that hand at Disadvantage until a Long Rest. Gain 1 Stress.

name: Sprained wrist
text: Out. Hand / wrist injury: -20 Handle (dominant) or -10 (other) on actions with that hand.

name: Tagged at the ankle
text: Out.

name: Clipped
text: Out. Lose the next Movement Stage.

name: Charley horse
text: Out. Next Speed Check at Disadvantage.

name: Legs taken out
text: Out. Knocked down.

name: Tripped flat
text: Out. Knocked down. Gain 1 Stress.

name: Dead leg
text: Out. Speed Checks at Disadvantage for the rest of the scene.
